message: No detected input validation: The code loads the CSV and applies transformations (mask, fillna, iloc slicing) but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards to validate the structure or content of the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local CSV file path ('gimnasio.csv') with no remote fetch, and no checksum verification or integrity checks are performed on the file.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no validation of label distributions, comparison against expected label sets, or use of any label-noise detection tool in the preparation code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code only fills missing values and applies min-max scaling; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code does not load any pretrained serialized model (no pickle, joblib, or similar deserialization), so no integrity verification (hash check, signature, pinned revision) is performed or needed in this snippet.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates the expected label set, or detects anomalous training samples before training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are imported or used in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; the code is primarily a Dash visualization app with preprocessing.

No detected input sanitization: The code loads CSV data and applies min-max scaling and forward/backfill imputation, but there are no shape checks, range validation, schema enforcement, or rejection of malformed inputs on any inference request path.
No detected output bounds checks: No code is visible that checks model output values for NaN, out-of-range probabilities, or any other sanity bounds before returning results.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses tabular ML models (XGBoost, RandomForest, LogisticRegression, etc.), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
